lines: You probably wonder why you ended up here.
You are [red]dead[/red], Your Honour. And I have questions.
Pull it, and you are a [red]killer[/red] with a calculator. Leave it, and you are a [red]killer[/red] with an alibi.
Then I show you how everyone else chose.
Cure [red]cancer[/red], lose [amber]one country[/amber]. Chosen at random.
Eternal [amber]burritos[/amber]. You do not even have a stomach.
Eventually, I give you a gun.
And the questions that really matter.
I am not judging you, Your Honour. I am [amber]reading[/amber] you.
Play it, or do not. It all goes in the book.
